faqs.question: When is Witr prayer prayed?
faqs.answer: Witr is prayed after Isha and before Fajr. Many Muslims pray it as the last prayer of the night, but a person who fears missing it may pray it before sleep.

faqs.question: How many rak'ahs are in Witr?
faqs.answer: Witr is prayed as an odd-numbered prayer. Common practices include one, three, five, seven, or more odd rak'ahs depending on madhhab and local teaching.

faqs.question: Is Witr obligatory?
faqs.answer: Scholars differ in wording and legal classification. The Hanafi school commonly treats Witr as wajib, while many other Sunni scholars classify it as a strongly emphasized Sunnah. Follow your madhhab or local scholar.

faqs.question: How do you pray Witr prayer?
faqs.answer: Witr is prayed after Isha and before Fajr with an odd number of rak'ahs. One- and three-rak'ah forms are common, but the arrangement, salam, and Qunut practice differ by madhhab, so follow the method taught by a trusted local teacher.

hero.titleHtml: Witr Prayer: last prayer of the night.
hero.introductionHtml: Witr is the odd-numbered night prayer offered after Isha and before Fajr, often kept as the final prayer before sleep or before dawn.
hero.summaryHtml:
• When: after Isha and before Fajr.
  • Meaning: an odd-numbered prayer that closes the night.
  • Common forms: one, three, five, seven, or other odd rak'ahs.
  • Note: ruling and Qunut details differ by madhhab.
